newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Woman burns to death in 52-car pile-up in S.Africa.
newsitem.headline: Woman burns to death in 52-car pile-up in S.Africa.

text.p: A woman burnt to death on Tuesday in a 52-car pile-up on one of South Africa's busiest highways in poor weather, officials said.
Ten other travellers were injured on the main arterial route between Johannesburg and the Indian Ocean port city of Durban.
Road officials said the young woman died inside one of four vehicles which had caught fire after the pile-up which officials say followed a collision between two trucks in thick mist and heavy rains.

"At about 7 a.m. (0500 GMT), 47 light motor vehicles and five heavy vehicles were involved in a chain of accidents stretching for almost two kilometers (over a mile)," road traffic inspectorate official John Schnell told Reuters.
The highway was closed for about six hours while officials tried to free people trapped in their cars and towed away the wrecks.
